title: Quenched Charred Japanese Rice Curry
description: A smoky, one-pot rice curry with madras paste, charred on a skillet for a crunchy crust, served egg-free and vegetarian.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the vegetable oil until shimmering.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic, sautéing for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the sliced carrot and bell pepper, cooking until they begin to soften, about 3 minutes.
Sprinkle the madras curry paste over the vegetables, stirring to coat and allowing the flavors to bloom for 1 minute.
Add the cubed tofu and cook, turning occasionally, until the tofu starts to brown, about 4 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth, soy sauce, and mirin, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Reduce heat to medium and let the curry reduce slightly, about 5 minutes, while stirring occasionally.
Fold in the cooked rice, stirring to combine, then press the mixture into a flat layer in the pan.
Allow the rice to char for 2-3 minutes on each side, using a spatula to flip only once, until a crispy crust forms.
Serve hot, optionally garnishing with fresh cilantro or sliced scallions.
